svg.title: Keep the old. Add the relevant.
svg.desc: The decider receives the bounded user task and short summaries of skills, tools or MCP-server and extension tool groups. It scores only candidates not already available and adds the best qualifying matches up to the per-round limit. Earlier choices and always-allowed items stay available. Skill advertisements contain descriptions, not full skill files; selected tools become available. Skill and tool selection are independent, and tool filtering is off by default. The picker does not receive skill bodies, tool arguments or results, or conversation transcripts.
